record.summary: Framework law promoting the use of AI for economic and social development in a secure environment that guarantees its ethical, sustainable, transparent, replicable and responsible use. Its principles include risk-based safety standards, multi-stakeholder participation, ethical development and privacy. It makes the Presidency of the Council of Ministers, through its Secretariat of Government and Digital Transformation, the national technical-normative authority to direct, evaluate and supervise AI use; the authority reports to Congress every year and must immediately inform its Intelligence Committee of serious threats or breaches of national cybersecurity.
record.notes: Approved by Congress on 13 Jun 2023, promulgated on 4 Jul 2023 and published in El Peruano on 5 Jul 2023. The law sets no date of its own for entry into force, so the date recorded is the day after publication, 6 Jul 2023, the Constitution's general rule for laws. Its single final complementary provision required the Executive to approve the regulation within 90 working days of entry into force; the regulation was approved by Supreme Decree No. 115-2025-PCM, signed on 8 Sep 2025 and published on 9 Sep 2025 (record PE-02). Congress's consolidated text shows no amendment of the law.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026: re-read Congress's consolidated text of Law No. 31814 (stored 11 Oct 2026 from leyes.congreso.gob.pe, found unchanged on 17 Oct 2026). It confirms the number and title, the approval by Congress on 13 Jun 2023, the promulgation on 4 Jul 2023, the publication in El Peruano on 5 Jul 2023, the principles, the national authority and its reporting duties, and shows no amendment. Also stored in this run: Supreme Decree No. 115-2025-PCM as published in El Peruano (busquedas.elperuano.pe, 17 Oct 2026), which confirms the regulation's number, its signature on 8 Sep 2025 and publication on 9 Sep 2025. The entry-into-force date rests on the Constitution's rule that a law binds from the day after its publication; the copy of the Constitution requested for Article 109 (diresapuno.gob.pe) returned HTTP 404, so that rule is not in a stored file. Bills to amend the law were seen in Congress's bill database but are not stored; none is shown as enacted.

judgment.status_reasoning: The law was promulgated on 4 Jul 2023 ('Mando se publique y cumpla') and published in El Peruano on 5 Jul 2023. It contains no vacatio legis, so under Article 109 of the Constitution it has bound since the day after publication, 6 Jul 2023, which is before 18 Oct 2026. Congress's consolidated text shows no repeal or amendment, so 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI-specific framework law with a risk-based safety principle and a national AI authority; in scope with no note (unchanged).
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the promulgation date, 4 Jul 2023 ('a los cuatro días del mes de julio del año dos mil veintitrés'); date_in_force is 6 Jul 2023, the day after publication in El Peruano on 5 Jul 2023, by the constitutional rule. date_last_updated is cleared because the law has not been amended.

The Ministry of Justice's official edition of the Constitution of Peru (March 2019), for Article 109 (a law is binding from the day after its publication in the official gazette unless it postpones its own entry into force), on which date_in_force (6 Jul 2023) rests.
